review_id.description: The id of the review you worked, such as cr_01...

action.description: STAGED: you staged a candidate for the reviewer. NOTHING_TO_STAGE: the current candidate already holds, or no candidate can work. SKIPPED: you could not work the review. NEEDS_HUMAN: you cannot decide the review from what you can read, such as a sample behind a login wall or bot challenge; you staged nothing and the summary holds your evidence.

candidate_version.description: The review's candidate version after your last change, or the one you read.

handover_category.description: Why a human must take over, for NEEDS_HUMAN and NOTHING_TO_STAGE. PAGES_UNREADABLE: the pages or sample cannot be read, such as a login wall or bot challenge. NO_SHOP_WIDE_PATTERN: the URL sample supports no defensible shop-wide distinction of product URLs. CANDIDATE_ALREADY_HOLDS: the current candidate is right and the reviewer's verdict asks for nothing you can change. NO_WORKABLE_CANDIDATE: no candidate can work, such as a required value missing from the pages. OTHER: none of these. NONE: for STAGED and SKIPPED.

summary.description: What you staged and how you tested it, naming the page URLs.

risks.description: What may still be wrong, one entry each.
